blocks.text: Managing your media planning workflow in Chrome

Digital media planners juggle multiple campaigns and data sources. Chrome is often the center of this activity. You have dozens of tabs open for Google Ads, analytics dashboards, and client emails. This clutter slows you down.

items: Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab instantly.
Use ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to switch between tabs.
Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar when you need a new search.
Use ⌘ + W to close a tab that is no longer needed.

blocks.text: Using Chrome profiles for client separation
You likely work with several clients at once. Mixing their bookmarks and logins is a recipe for errors. Create a separate Chrome profile for each client. This keeps your cookies and history clean.
To create a new profile, click your profile icon in the top right corner of Chrome. Select Add and sign in with the client's specific email address. This ensures your work remains isolated.
blocks.title: Stay organized with profiles

blocks.text: Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold Option and Command to ask about anything on your screen. It can summarize a long article or point out a specific setting in your browser. It does not click buttons for you, but it guides you through complex tasks.

Performance matters when you are looking at live data. If Chrome feels slow, check your extensions. Go to Chrome > Settings > Extensions and remove anything you do not use daily. Extensions are a common source of browser instability.

items: Clear your cache if a dashboard stops updating correctly.
Block notifications from sites that interrupt your deep work.
Use Incognito mode for checking how ads appear to a user without logged-in history.

blocks.text: Media planners face hundreds of interruptions daily. Each one costs you about 23 minutes of focus. Use Lazur to dictate notes or emails while you are still looking at your research. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the data.
Advanced Chrome tips for data tasks

When you are in Google Sheets within Chrome, use the built-in search features. Press ⌘ + F to find specific campaign names. If you need to count unique values, use the unique function in your formulas. These small habits save you hours every week.

Start by auditing your current Chrome setup. Remove old extensions and set up dedicated profiles for your top three clients. Then, try using Lazur to dictate your next status update email. You will notice the difference in your daily pace.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Chrome for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It points at things and guides you one step at a time.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my screen data?
faq.answer: No. Lazur only sees your screen while you hold the shortcut. The screenshot is sent to an AI provider to answer your question and is never stored or used to train models.

faq.question: How do I fix an Aw Snap error in Chrome?
faq.answer: This usually indicates a memory issue or a conflicting extension. Try refreshing the page, closing other tabs, or disabling your extensions one by one.
